entries.title: A lower one-time price.
entries.summary: Trayage now costs US$9.99 once. The direct app opens the updated checkout.

highlights.title: Buy once for US$9.99
highlights.description: The direct license is now US$9.99 once, for up to three active Macs, including all 1.x updates. The App Store offers a separate US$9.99 one-time unlock in the US; Apple shows local pricing before purchase.

highlights.title: Try it before buying
highlights.description: File review stays free. The optional seven-day cleanup trial ends without an automatic charge.

highlights.title: Updated direct checkout
highlights.description: The Buy action in the direct app opens the new checkout. Existing direct licenses continue to work.

entries.title: Give Downloads a second look.
entries.summary: A new look shaped by your feedback, with more ways to find files worth reviewing.

highlights.title: A new look, light or dark
highlights.description: A new tray icon, violet colors, and a redesigned overview. Choose Glance or Quick review for the menu bar.

highlights.title: Make the review your own
highlights.description: Start with 14 smart-filter presets or save your own All/Any rules. Preview matches, pin favorites, and set age and size thresholds.

highlights.title: Check likely duplicates locally
highlights.description: Compare candidate file contents on your Mac, then decide which copies you need. Nothing is selected automatically.

highlights.title: Keep what matters
highlights.description: Hide a suggestion while keeping its file, and restore hidden suggestions in Settings. Optional folder-size reminders help you keep track of growing folders.

highlights.title: Clearer controls
highlights.description: Refined Settings and Billing, text sizes up to 200%, and visible refresh feedback. A personal thank-you from Kyle is available again in About.

highlights.title: Your existing purchase stays with you
highlights.description: The direct edition continues to use Stripe checkout and Keylight licenses. Existing settings and direct licenses stay with your installation. App Store purchases remain separate.

entries.title: Updates, made easier.
entries.summary: The direct edition can now check for updates and install them from inside Trayage.

highlights.title: Check from wherever you work
highlights.description: Find Check for Updates in the Trayage menu, menu-bar popover, General settings, and About.

highlights.title: Daily checks, with your permission
highlights.description: Allow automatic checks while Trayage is running. See what changed and choose when to download and install a signed update.

highlights.title: Appearance follows your Mac
highlights.description: Switching from Light to Device appearance now follows your Mac’s setting and keeps billing controls readable.

highlights.title: A one-time step for earlier builds
highlights.description: If your current copy has no update checker, download this DMG, quit Trayage, and replace it in Applications. Keep your app data to retain settings and licensing.

entries.title: A little order for your Downloads.
entries.summary: The first version brings file review and confirmed cleanup together in a Mac app.

highlights.title: Review before you clear
highlights.description: Review files in a selected folder, choose what to remove, and confirm before unchanged files move to Trash. Trayage never empties the Trash.

highlights.title: Close at hand
highlights.description: Open Trayage from the menu bar and move into the full review window when you need a closer look.

highlights.title: File review stays on your Mac
highlights.description: Trayage scans and groups files locally. Purchases, licensing, and support use the services described in the privacy policy.

highlights.title: Made for both kinds of Mac
highlights.description: The signed and notarized direct download runs on Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 14 or later.
